_comment: Source of truth for every benchmark number shown on 1bit.systems.
Binary SIZES are NOT here -- tools/gen_numbers.py stat()s the real binaries
on every build. Only numbers requiring hardware (ROCm GPU / XDNA2 NPU) live
here, and tools/validate_claims.py re-measures them every 24h.
RULE: a number may appear in `benchmarks` only if validate_claims.py can
re-measure it. Anything else belongs in `_unverified` and must NOT ship.

_measured_on.host: AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S
_measured_on.note: Zaya engine benchmark with full MoE expert weights on Radeon 8060S. Synthetic FP32 weights (33 GB). BackendManager correctly selected hip_gpu as fastest backend. Benchmark warm: 23.9 tok/s. Cold inference: 8.95 tok/s.

_sources.prefill_tflops_i8apre: bench_prefill_variants 2560 6912 2560 -- variant 4i-I8-APRE (I8 A + tiled B), median of 3
_sources.sherry_gemv_gbps: bench_sherry -- M=6912 K=2560, sherry kernel, 256 iters
_sources.tq1_gemv_gbps: bench_sherry -- tq1 kernel, fastest GEMV variant

_comment: Claims that cannot currently be re-measured from this repo.
They are deliberately absent from `benchmarks` and MUST NOT be published
until the blocker is fixed and validate_claims.py can measure them.

fused_kb_82.blocker: UNIT ERROR. This was the LM head's 82 MB copied into a KB field. The fused engine measures 258 KB (264,000 bytes), now stat()-ed at build time by tools/gen_numbers.py.

npu_fused_raw_tok_s.blocker: NO SOURCE anywhere in the repo. Contradicted by docs/npu/AGENTS.md (4.8 tok/s). Was hardcoded into site/index.html's meta description as a string literal, bypassing numbers.json entirely.

npu_tok_s.blocker: docs/npu/AGENTS.md reports 210 ms/tok on Qwen3-0.6B via the torch2aie/IRON toolchain. Not re-measurable here: no Q4NX model + xclbin harness wired into a benchmark binary.

npu_validated_tok_s.blocker: NO SOURCE. The string '94 tok/s' appears nowhere in the repository.

rocm_decode_tok_s.blocker: Model unreproducible. ~/models/bonsai-1.7b/bonsai-f16.gguf sidecar is truncated (502 KB, 'short read on token_embd'). tools/gguf_to_h1b segfaults (exit 139) regenerating it: Bonsai-1.7B-F16.gguf is not F16 -- 197 of 310 tensors are dtype 41, and the converter only reads dtype 1 (F16), warns 'missing blk.N.*.weight' for every layer, writes a truncated sidecar, then crashes.

rocm_prefill_tok_s.blocker: Same as rocm_decode_tok_s -- requires a loadable .h1b model.

rocm_tflops.blocker: FALSIFIED. CLAUDE.md attributes 28.4 TFlops to variant 4h; 4h measures 25.67 TFlops. The fastest variant is 4i-I8-APRE at 35.57 TFlops. Superseded by prefill_tflops_best / prefill_tflops_4h.

sherry_gemv_bw_gbps.blocker: MISATTRIBUTED. 19.3 GB/s is close to sherry_ref (18.2 GB/s), the clean-room offline-only reference implementation -- not the shipped kernel, which measures 148.8 GB/s.

tflops_55_7.blocker: NO SOURCE. Measured ternary prefill peak is 35.57 TFlops.

_verify._comment: How validate_claims.py re-measures each key. Median of --repeat runs; tolerance is fractional.
